problem: A default-normal non-rational spline HATCH boundary imports its control points at zero height, so its shared nonzero source elevation is lost.

authority.title: Autodesk Boundary Path Data (DXF)
authority.scope: Spline control and fit points are 2D OCS positions; tangents are 2D vectors.

patch.base: Incremental candidate patch applied after the P8 curved-edge elevation patch and its recorded downstream dependencies; not standalone on LibreCAD_3 master.
patch.application: git apply --check and apply PASS on isolated exact preimages; patched files byte-match the tested files. Existing user LibreCAD_3 checkout untouched.
patch.implementation: Lift default-normal control and fit points to the entity plane; preserve tangent vectors. Include eligible non-rational splines in the shared finite common-plane check. Once a common output elevation is proved, put it on the HATCH and clear spline point Z in the temporary 2D DXF edge object; leave unsupported/mixed profiles outside this normalization.

validation.baseline: A locally generated quadratic spline edge fails imported and reopened control point Z checks before the patch.
validation.focused: 8/8 selected tests pass for both bundled and current shared codecs, including a non-rational quadratic spline with three controls, two fit points, knots and start/end tangents; ASCII/Binary save/reopen, mixed-height destination handling, corrected same-document retry and seven prior HATCH/MPOLYGON controls.
validation.independentReader: ezdxf 1.4.5 checks all parsed spline edge fields and elevation against the original DXF plus physical ASCII/Binary signatures; output-specific hashes are below.

bundled.mixed: flattened with loss warning in focused test

limits: This is an unmerged downstream patch, not native GUI, platform or whole-file qualification.
The tested profile is default-normal and non-rational. Rational weights, periodic cases, tilted planes and DWG MPOLYGON source geometry remain separately unqualified.

For the selected mixed-height spline, current codec refuses and preserves the destination; bundled codec emits a flattened output with a loss warning. Neither behavior is claimed for other invalid profiles. No fixture files were committed.
